title: Secrets
intro: Values your pipeline jobs need, such as tokens and passwords. They are encrypted and write-only: nobody can read a value back, not even administrators.
emptyHint: Add a secret, then list it under a job's secrets: in .opshub.yml.
noAccessHint: Ask a project admin if you need to manage them.
createIntro: The value is encrypted and can't be shown again. Jobs receive it as an environment variable with the secret's name.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Becomes the environment variable, e.g. DB_URL.
form.scopeHint: An environment's secret wins over an all-environments secret with the same name.
form.scopeHintDeveloper: Developers can add secrets to unprotected environments only.
form.valueHint: Stored encrypted. It won't be shown again.

rotateIntro: The new value becomes the next version and the old one is destroyed. Jobs that start from now on receive the new value.
deleteBody: Its value is destroyed. Jobs that list it will fail until a secret with this name exists again.
historyIntro: Who set each value and when. Older values are destroyed when a secret is rotated.
howJobs: A job receives only the secrets it lists under secrets: in .opshub.yml, as environment variables. A job with an environment gets that environment's secret, otherwise the all-environments one.
howMasked: Values are masked in job logs, and every time a runner receives one it is recorded in the audit log.
howPullRequests: Pull-request runs never receive secrets: their pipeline file comes from the pull request itself.
